flags.help: grouping method: ext (extension only, no sniffing), type (content-sniff every file), hybrid (trust known text extensions, content-sniff everything else)
flags.name: method

flags.help: maximum directory depth below the root; -1 = unlimited; the root is depth 0
flags.name: depth

flags.help: exact base name to skip, matching directories and files; repeatable; passing the flag replaces the built-in default list entirely
flags.name: exclude

flags.help: path to a TOML scan-config file (keys: exclude, method, depth, ignored, hidden, type, stats, sort_by, sort_order); never auto-discovered; a key set both in the file and on the command line is an error
flags.name: config

flags.help: gitignored-path handling: include (no matching at all), exclude (drop ignored paths), only (keep only ignored paths); when the target is not inside a git work tree, exclude and only behave as if no patterns exist
flags.name: ignored

flags.help: dot-prefixed entry handling: include or exclude; the root directory itself is never treated as hidden
flags.name: hidden

flags.help: stat to compute and show (repeatable; default: all): count, total-size, min-size, max-size, avg-size, total-loc, min-loc, max-loc, avg-loc
flags.name: stats

flags.help: filter groups by text/binary classification: text, binary, or both
flags.name: type

flags.help: sort column, in precedence order when repeated: format, count, total-size, min-size, max-size, avg-size, total-loc, min-loc, max-loc, avg-loc
flags.name: sort-by

flags.help: sort direction: asc or desc, applied uniformly to every --sort-by column
flags.name: sort-order

flags.help: keep only the first N groups after sorting (table output only); -1 or 0 = all
flags.name: top

flags.help: output format: table (colored terminal tables) or json (stable machine-readable schema)
flags.name: output

flags.help: sections to render: summary, table, or both (table output only)
flags.name: show

flags.help: render one merged table with text and binary rows distinguished by color, instead of separate text/binary tables
flags.name: combined

flags.help: show one-file formats as-is, or collapse them into a single (singletons) row (table output only)
flags.name: singletons

flags.help: list the paths of extensionless files (a section in table output, a field in JSON output)
flags.name: list-no-ext

flags.help: show the text/binary color legend under the combined table (needs active colors)
flags.name: legend

flags.help: use ANSI colors; auto-disabled when stdout is not a TTY
flags.name: colors

flags.help: human-readable sizes and thousands separators (table output only)
flags.name: human

flags.help: table border character set: unicode box-drawing characters or plain ASCII borders
flags.name: style

scan.help: Summarize the files under a directory tree, grouped by format, with counts, sizes, and lines of code as terminal tables or JSON.
scan.name: scan

help: Summarize files in a directory tree, grouped by format, with aggregate statistics
name: dirstat
